payload.summary: The record of the meeting where the proposals were tested, and of the only change anyone pressed for. Officers took members through the five proposed changes and told them 72 responses had come in. The committee suggested no changes to the proposals, then by a majority vote asked Cabinet to consider removing a rule the officers had not proposed touching — paragraph 3.8.7.3, which withholds that extra priority where the children were already born when the family accepted the property. Members also asked for more about the council's assessment panel to be written into the policy, and for research on co-parenting in council homes to come back to a later meeting.
